hypothesis: Rule 90 evolved from a single black cell produces a pattern in which the triangle of the first 2^k steps is composed exactly of three copies of the triangle of the first 2^(k-1) steps (one on top, two below, with an all-white inverted triangle between them), for every k up to the depth simulated, and its rows coincide with Pascal's triangle modulo 2 as tabulated independently in OEIS A001317.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered: (1) for every k = 1..11 the 2^k-step triangle decomposes exactly (zero mismatching cells) into three copies of the 2^(k-1)-step triangle plus an all-white central inverted triangle; and (2) every simulated row t whose value is present in the OEIS A001317 b-file equals A001317(t) when the row's cells at positions of parity t are read as a binary number (zero mismatching rows).
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: any cell of the simulated pattern violates the three-copy decomposition at some k <= 11, or any simulated row differs from the independently tabulated A001317 value.
interpretation: 'Nested triangular pieces that all have exactly the same form' is operationalised as exact self-similarity under doubling: the pattern of the first 2^k steps is three translated copies of the pattern of the first 2^(k-1) steps separated by an empty (white) inverted triangle; iterated down to k = 1 this means every triangular piece is a scaled copy of the whole. The rule is the Wolfram rule 90 (new colour = XOR of the two neighbours), started from one black cell on an otherwise white infinite line, which is simulated exactly on a line wide enough that boundaries never matter. As an independent external check the rows are compared with OEIS A001317 (Sierpinski's triangle rows read as binary numbers), which is tabulated independently of any cellular-automaton code.

datasets.name: Elementary cellular automaton rule 90 from a single black cell, 2048 steps (generated by analysis.py)
datasets.program_family: elementary cellular automaton, Wolfram rule number 90 (rule bit k = new colour for neighbourhood 4*left + 2*centre + right); initial condition: single black cell at x = 0 on a line of 4097 white cells (x = -2048..2048), fixed white boundaries that are never reached; steps t = 0..2047
datasets.role: the pattern whose nesting is tested

datasets.name: OEIS A001317: Sierpinski's triangle (Pascal's triangle mod 2) converted to decimal, b-file
datasets.role: independent tabulation of rule-90 rows from a single cell (row t read as binary)
